confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of budget-to-mid-range Thai island pricing, not live listings. Restaurant anchors (meals, beer, coffee) are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and location, and July falls in the Andaman green/low season. Cocktail and wine_glass are estimated from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 1.7x beer, wine about 2x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. Figures are approximate and should be treated as bounded ranges rather than precise quotes.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: budget-to-mid-range Andaman islands and coastal Thai resort towns (Krabi province, Ko Chang and Ko Samet-style island tiers), priced somewhat below Phuket and Ko Samui. Koh Lanta is a quieter, less developed island, so its restaurant and guesthouse prices are set lower than the most touristed hubs.
